## Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Property Listings
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100224

## Settings Documentation for Streaming Property Listings
This document provides detailed descriptions of the settings available for configuring the streaming property listings section on the platform. Each setting allows for customization to meet specific needs and preferences.
To edit these settings, navigate to:
In the Admin Sidebar Open Settings
Select Designs Settings
Open The Homepage Tab
Open The Module Select Content to Display
Select The Streaming Property Listings Option
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144451936/original/mCACuL1cpbKqkLLp_J3XFOifcEDaWHR2ug.png?1717718006 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144452215/original/xXAy4I62Hh0g5yUbLUxtRzW50c7QTNeOtw.png?1717718463 | alt: ]

## Visual Guide of the  Streaming Properties
These are the available settings for the Streaming Products section:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144452370/original/cvyGN1hLwXXxnxKbfJqDLDo5GEOp_NLWRg.png?1717718826 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144452403/original/4MBwN2uDn84lGblDWcnwya4Qh13HTHzZxQ.png?1717719024 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144452405/original/D44NARUr8QP4NxbRO9vKr3ngnv94Ocoeow.png?1717719034 | alt: ]

## 1. Recent Properties Title
This setting allows the administrator to set the title for the recent properties section. The title can be customized by entering the desired text in the provided input field.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144655647/original/NBCjMNrqGPzx855VRgmscpzdy7cys4ztrA.png?1718119977 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144452642/original/Utb0utc6WpUl04GMvLV74RCS4d8HgJuNSg.png?1717719660 | alt: ]

## 2. Title Color
The title color setting enables the customization of the title's color. Administrators can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144655937/original/_n9VX-IWrqXr1W5-ZWdI1rPpavqf0_4SIw.png?1718120185 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144661657/original/7gM_WQlI5XCvI8UEWubeJAIEIEFG7X8iRQ.png?1718124418 | alt: ]

## 3. Display Options
This setting controls the number of recent properties displayed. Administrators can select from a range of options, from 1 to 24 results. Additionally, the layout can be adjusted to show a specific number of results per row, ranging from 2 to 4 results per row.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144661686/original/xIRpPYR_Xn2aPLXFF6qAPeHFWy7D4fSKgQ.png?1718124464 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144661657/original/7gM_WQlI5XCvI8UEWubeJAIEIEFG7X8iRQ.png?1718124418 | alt: ]

## 4. Enable Carousel Slider
The carousel slider option allows recent properties to be displayed in a sliding carousel format. This can be toggled on or off using the provided dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144661686/original/xIRpPYR_Xn2aPLXFF6qAPeHFWy7D4fSKgQ.png?1718124464 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144662157/original/_twUsxbcPIsN84vjq6H8IDs5jf49TF9Vww.png?1718124871 | alt: ]

## 5. Hide On Mobile
This setting allows administrators to choose whether the recent properties section should be hidden on mobile devices. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144662208/original/7hPjZRU3bh4LKMIfXSZ6lGw9G0VM5KqM6g.png?1718124914 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144662241/original/ZiJrYyut7O3RYuBxeQzq51nyHFjKoSt-IA.png?1718124956 | alt: ]

## 6. Linked Post Type
This setting allows the administrator to select the type of content linked to the recent properties. Options include classified, photo album, property, product, prizes, and prizes pro.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145019582/original/ze9kGdOWz90rjU5WAv31lqOuBE3O3OGd9g.png?1718724136 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145019808/original/IIFvxN_aMrjG-c8Z3rdvLU9O5wYb9LKGbw.png?1718724256 | alt: ]

## 7. Only Show Posts with Photos
Administrators can choose to display only those posts that have photos. This setting ensures that posts without photos are excluded from the recent properties list.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145019797/original/BMh0vYeFtXbyHij_hcQQ0-suTD5Js9zedg.png?1718724245 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145019809/original/zZt0RMd33HzMjC8FVYVCiDOv3yhFKsRnBw.png?1718724261 | alt: ]

## 8. Image Quality
This setting controls the quality of the images displayed in the recent properties. Administrators can choose between thumbnail size and large size.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145019843/original/prh738hARTyOu5qwi8F7V18e-cFTV8Rp_A.png?1718724293 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145019809/original/zZt0RMd33HzMjC8FVYVCiDOv3yhFKsRnBw.png?1718724261 | alt: ]

## 9. Show "View All" Button
The "View All" button allows users to see all recent properties. This setting can be toggled on or off using the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145019915/original/a9RolEefWm2x72d7xjdel-0EzghqAO8iEA.png?1718724335 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020018/original/l910QR4Lqy8CcnyOcs3fRg9EPP7W8vEH2Q.png?1718724417 | alt: ]

## 10. Hide If No Posts Exist
This setting allows administrators to choose whether the recent properties section should be hidden if no posts exist. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020349/original/gVCqZ8SZA-pkF2UCvM23hwjHSiVL7_TtWQ.png?1718724618 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020435/original/6YFHcQK3cWzYxfidF_k89efDLiS27u_B2g.png?1718724678 | alt: ]

## 11. Only Include Posts from Active Members
This setting specifies whether only posts from active members should be included. Administrators can choose to include posts from active members only or from all members.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020432/original/tDFyk0OpzJYw4s3zCqahrmE9HKyqVGalYQ.png?1718724667 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020439/original/f2QvR1z0Rxa3oScluRi0zLzLpJ6jREM2Yw.png?1718724685 | alt: ]

## 12. Include Posts from Non-Searchable Members
This setting allows administrators to choose whether to include posts from non-searchable members. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020482/original/25QYIuJt9rAbZ-UPJ6JWzZ_YnHvwn_-oNw.png?1718724715 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020439/original/f2QvR1z0Rxa3oScluRi0zLzLpJ6jREM2Yw.png?1718724685 | alt: ]

## 13. Show Property Details
This setting allows the administrator to choose whether to display property details. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020573/original/vSKYy4-GA3uaTmh73fUPj3b6VFq2S4fvhw.png?1718724782 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020439/original/f2QvR1z0Rxa3oScluRi0zLzLpJ6jREM2Yw.png?1718724685 | alt: ]

## 14. Include Posts from Members in These Plans
This setting allows administrators to limit the displayed posts to specific membership plans. Administrators can select the desired membership plans from the provided list.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020880/original/SaEuiVKxJFDkBTygq-x6jz36Fi6nfKZaTA.png?1718725024 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020439/original/f2QvR1z0Rxa3oScluRi0zLzLpJ6jREM2Yw.png?1718724685 | alt: ]

## 15. Display Order
The display order setting determines the order in which recent properties are shown. Options include newest first, oldest first, and random order. This can be customized by selecting the desired option from the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020914/original/gs0El86hk_47pxV0quUXWiLA7GZLqvs4Mg.png?1718725058 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020439/original/f2QvR1z0Rxa3oScluRi0zLzLpJ6jREM2Yw.png?1718724685 | alt: ]

## 16. Limit One Post per Member?
This setting specifies whether only one post per member should be displayed. Administrators can choose to display one post per member or allow multiple posts from the same member.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020938/original/1wYyao7umf9xcKDLoRI6FTZ3xbPurQkQvw.png?1718725098 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145020439/original/f2QvR1z0Rxa3oScluRi0zLzLpJ6jREM2Yw.png?1718724685 | alt: ]
